AfterDeath.rationale: RE-EXECUTED 2026-07-30: re-read CrabRagePower.cs and the current sim class side by side, and every claim this entry's own prose already made checks out with nothing left over. Constants match (STRENGTH_GAIN=6 / BLOCK_GAIN=99, powers.py:2941-2942, vs CrabRagePower.cs:25-29's PowerVar<StrengthPower>(6m) / BlockVar(99m, Unpowered)), the Block grant carries `props=VP.UNPOWERED` (powers.py:2951), the guard order matches (`creature is self.owner or creature.side != self.owner.side: return`, powers.py:2946, the De Morgan complement of CrabRagePower.cs:33's `creature != base.Owner && creature.Side == base.Owner.Side`), and the effect order matches (Strength, then Block, then `self._expire()`, powers.py:2950-2952). Both sides still lack an IsDead guard, so a dead-but-retained arm still rages in both models -- a faithfully-reproduced asymmetry, not a bug. THIS HOOK MAPPING HAS NO DIVERGENCE OF ITS OWN: the entry's own closing sentence already said 'the gap is the missing applier= on the Strength grant, below' -- pointing at guards[0] (mechanism power/crab_rage/g1), a separate JSON node with its own verdict. Filing this hook as `gap` duplicated that one finding under two mechanism ids with nothing new at this one, so it is corrected to `faithful` here; guards[0] carries the real (dormant) finding, settled in the same pass below.

guards.issue: MISSING `applier=`. C# passes `base.Owner` (`PowerCmd.Apply<StrengthPower>(choiceContext, base.Owner, ..., base.Owner, null)`); the sim's `PowerCmd.apply(self.hooks, self.owner, StrengthPower, self.STRENGTH_GAIN)` (powers.py:2950) omits the kwarg, so `applier` is None through hooks.modify_power_amount (cmds.py:553), hooks.on_power_applied and hooks.on_power_amount_changed, and the granted StrengthPower's `.applier` is left None (powers.py:88). Recurring gap shape 5. DORMANT, RE-EXECUTED 2026-07-30 (`py audit/tools/power_slot_probes.py applier-readers`, 10 hits): every applier READER in the tree was read at its current line and none of them observes an enemy's own Strength self-buff. `_PossessPower._track` (powers.py:3603-3608) needs `applier is self.owner AND name == self._stat_id AND target.side == "player" AND delta < 0` -- CrabRage's target is an enemy with a positive delta, failing three of the four clauses. DampenPower.on_death (powers.py:3691-3695) and HexPower.on_death (powers.py:3745-3748) both test `creature is self.applier` against a DIFFERENT power instance's own stored applier at a creature's DEATH, not against a live Strength grant's applier -- irrelevant to this site by construction. UnsettlingLamp.modify_power_amount (relics/unsettling_lamp.py:45-54) requires `applier is self.player` (fails: None is not the player either way) AND `power_cls.power_type == DEBUFF` (fails outright: Strength is a BUFF), so the missing applier changes nothing there regardless. CITATION FIX: RitualPower no longer reads applier at all -- its own comment (powers.py:262-268) says the port used to test `applier.side != owner.side` and doesn't anymore ('The APPLIER is not consulted at all'), so the old citation to powers.py:195 is stale; RitualPower is not part of this enumeration. Reproduce with `py audit/tools/power_slot_probes.py applier-readers`. HANDOFF: power/high_voltage and power/territorial are recorded elsewhere as the same gap shape (rule 3) -- not owned by this file, not re-verdicted here; see report HANDOFF section.
